'''Makara''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] and [[Oskara]]'s sister.

==Biography==
Makara was a native of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and Oskara's sister. When she was captured by [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] thugs to work in the [[Ryll/Legends|Ryll]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] mines, Oskara offered her services to the gang leader as an "experienced [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]." Her first job went well and she was mentored by [[Gyax]], a veteran hunter. Oskara continued to work for the spice mine gang to keep her sister safe.<ref name="EotEBG" />
